en.short_description: Build a grocery list, find supermarkets near you and compare Nutri-Scores.
en.description:
GroceryMatch keeps your grocery list, finds the supermarkets around you and shows real nutrition data for what you buy. It never fills a screen with made-up prices, deals or savings: where it has no real data, it says so.

SHOPPING LIST
Build your list by typing, quick-adding or browsing aisles, and share it with anyone.

STORES NEAR YOU
See the supermarkets around your approximate location on a map, with addresses and straight-line distances from OpenStreetMap.

BARCODE LOOKUP
Enter a barcode to identify a product and see its ingredients, allergens and Nutri-Score from Open Food Facts.

HEALTHIER ALTERNATIVES
Search a product type and compare matching products ranked by their published Nutri-Score, with sugar and protein per 100 g.

MEAL PLANNER AND PANTRY
Pick from a week of recipes, add the ingredients to your list in one tap, and keep track of what is already in the cupboard: mark items as running low or out, and add them back to your list.

BUDGET
Set a monthly grocery budget and keep it in one place.

—— About prices ——

GroceryMatch does not show store prices yet: it has no live price source, and it will not guess one.

—— No account needed ——

Tap "Continue as Guest" to use the app without an account. Your list, pantry and budget are stored on this device.

en.release_notes:
GroceryMatch 2.1.

• "Continue as Guest" now works without an account; your data stays on this device
• Stores near you come from OpenStreetMap, around your approximate location
• Barcode lookup now shows ingredients and allergens alongside the Nutri-Score
• Your pantry is saved, and items can be edited, marked low or out, and removed
• Healthier alternatives use real Nutri-Scores from Open Food Facts
• Budget uses the budget you set
• Removed tabs and screens that had no live data behind them (prices, deals, savings, dining, notifications)

Feedback is welcome at contact@americangroup.ai.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
GroceryMatch keeps your grocery list, finds the supermarkets around you and shows real nutrition data for what you buy. It never fills a screen with made-up prices, deals or savings: where it has no real data, it says so.

Intended audience:
Grocery lists & nearby stores

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional: tap "Continue as Guest" to reach every feature without signing in. Guest mode creates no account; the list, pantry and budget are stored on the device.

The bottom tabs are My List, Stores (nearby supermarkets), Barcode (type a barcode to see Nutri-Score, ingredients and allergens), Healthier (Nutri-Score alternatives) and Profile (Pantry, Meal Planner, Budget, Grocery chains, Privacy, Help).

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Authentication (Google) — sign-in
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In and Sign in with Apple — the buttons appear only when that sign-in provider is enabled for the app; email sign-in and guest mode always work
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints
- OpenStreetMap (Overpass API) — nearby supermarkets
- Open Food Facts — product and nutrition data
- ipapi.co — approximate location for nearby stores

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The interface is in English. The app declares 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but only shared navigation and system strings are translated so far; most screens are English. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Signed-in users can delete their account in the app: Profile tab > Delete Account (at the bottom). Deletion can also be requested by email to contact@americangroup.ai, as described on the support site.
